text:
maria_sales: FYI prospect NorthAurora wants a POC with a committed capacity guarantee. They want predictability for planned ad waves: steady ~340 QPS, spikes to ~1.9k QPS, mixed chat+embed. Ask: recommended reserved GPUs, burst model, and a preheat + SLA protection clause.
henry_sre: Quick clarifying q: which model and region are they pinning? Any compliance needs?
zara_eng: They pinned redwood/llm-7b-quantized in eu-west-1. HIPAA in scope, so KMS + audit logs required. Traffic split ~60% chat (avg 140 tokens) / 40% embeddings (512 dim). Peak concurrency ~1250.
tony_solution: Pricing ask: they want an explicit monthly committed line item and a capped burst pool they can buy (to avoid surprise overages). Also want a preheat guarantee so p99 doesn't tank during campaign starts.
maria_sales: Exactly. They asked if we can promise p99 during campaigns if they buy a preheat block.
henry_sre: Operational reality: p99 SLA depends on reserved capacity + warmed KV. Recommend we include an optional preheat add-on (X GPU-hrs before campaign) and make p99 guarantee conditioned on that plus following runbook steps.
zara_eng: Sizing calc quick: mixed effective throughput ~62 qps/GPU on A100-80GB for these stats. Steady 340 -> round up to 6 GPUs reserved. Peak 1900 -> ~31 GPUs total, so burst pool ~25 GPUs. Reserve 6, burst up to 25.
tony_solution: Suggest contract lanes: 6 reserved GPUs at M/mo, burst credit pool up to 25 GPUs billed per-GPU-hour at burst rate B/hr, optional preheat package (6 GPU-hrs per campaign start) at one-time fee P. Include explicit clause: p99 SLA applies when preheat purchased and KV hit rate >= 75%.
maria_sales: Good. They also insisted on an AZ-failure plan (what if an AZ dies mid-campaign?).
henry_sre: Recommend AZ spread for reserved nodes (min 3 AZs for resilience). For AZ outage mid-campaign, route traffic to remaining AZs and enable regional fallback if needed. Note: cross-region failover requires replicated KV and doubles preheat cost. Document tradeoffs in proposal.
zara_eng: Add model-variant fallback: route overflow to llm-7b-q4f16 when saturated. Canary 10% during early surge, escalate to max 40% if eval drift < 1.5%. Provide quality delta disclaimer in SLA appendix.
tony_solution: Can we offer a soft cap: after Y hours of sustained burst we trigger traffic shaping and a joint ops call? Customer wants "no surprise" billing but we must protect cluster. Put that in the contract as an emergency mitigation flow.
henry_sre: Autoscale knobs: reserved.nodes=6, min=6, max=31, scale_up_window=60s, scale_down_cooldown=600s. Example config block to include in appendix:
```
reserved_capacity:
  reserved_nodes: 6
  min_nodes: 6
  max_nodes: 31
  scale_up: {threshold_qps: 380, cooldown_sec: 60}
  scale_down: {threshold_qps: 260, cooldown_sec: 600}
fallbacks:
  - variant: llm-7b-q4f16
    canary_pct: 10
    max_pct_on_surge: 40
```

maria_sales: Perfect. Also they asked for preheat token estimates and time.
zara_eng: Preheat estimate: warming common KV prefixes ~220M tokens -> ~3.5 GPU-hours per region; recommend a 6-hour preheat window before major campaigns to hit steady KV hit rates. If they want cross-region replication, double that.
tony_solution: Pricing exhibit: include three scenarios: monthly baseline (steady usage), campaign-week (one 48h campaign), worst-case sustained (72h sustained high traffic). Show cost breakdown: reserved fee, burst credit usage, preheat add-ons, and private/KMS surcharge.
maria_sales: Ops checklist they expect in contract: preheat schedule, KV hit monitoring, tail-latency alarm thresholds, escalation contact, and a clause for emergency throttling.
henry_sre: I'll draft the ops runbook and the conditional SLA language (p99 conditional on preheat + KV hit rate). Include steps for rerouting to fallback variant and rollback thresholds.
zara_eng: I'll prepare an engineering appendix with per-GPU throughput and tail latency for 6/12/20/31 nodes and expected token costs. I'll also include an eval plan for fallback quality checks.
ops-bot: Created ticket #PR-11237: "NorthAurora POC 1: sizing appendix + preheat SLA exhibit + KMS wording" assigned to zara_eng, henry_sre, tony_solution, due 2026-04-15. :white_check_mark:
maria_sales: Thanks all. I'll send the proposal draft to the customer and schedule a contract review with Legal next Tue 9am CET.
All: "ack ":thumbsup: "will finalize docs before the call."
